Description: Validates that invoice number (IBT-001) is present
Pass Condition: Invoice number field is not empty
Fail Condition: Invoice number field is empty or missing
Suggested Fix: Ensure every invoice has a unique invoice number assigned before submission
Evidence Required: Invoice document or source system export showing invoice number

Description: Validates that invoice issue date (IBT-002) is present
Pass Condition: Issue date field is not empty
Fail Condition: Issue date field is empty or missing
Suggested Fix: Populate the issue date field with the actual invoice date in YYYY-MM-DD format

Description: Validates issue date is in YYYY-MM-DD format (IBT-002)
Pass Condition: Issue date matches YYYY-MM-DD pattern
Fail Condition: Issue date does not match required format
Suggested Fix: Convert date to ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) before submission
Evidence Required: System configuration showing date format settings

Description: Validates invoice type code (IBT-003) is present
Pass Condition: Invoice type code field is not empty
Fail Condition: Invoice type code is missing
Suggested Fix: Specify the invoice type (e.g., 380 for standard invoice, 381 for credit note)

Description: Validates document currency code (IBT-005) is present
Pass Condition: Currency code field is not empty
Fail Condition: Currency code is missing
Suggested Fix: Specify the transaction currency using ISO 4217 alpha-3 code

Description: Validates currency is ISO 4217 alpha-3 format (IBT-005)
Pass Condition: Currency exists in official ISO4217 codelist
Fail Condition: Currency value is not in official ISO4217 codelist
Suggested Fix: Use standard ISO 4217 codes (e.g., AED, USD, EUR)

Description: Validates tax accounting basis currency is AED (BTUAE-001)
Pass Condition: Tax amounts are calculated/reported in AED
Fail Condition: Non-AED tax accounting without proper FX conversion
Suggested Fix: Ensure tax calculations use AED as the tax accounting currency per UAE VAT law
Evidence Required: Tax calculation documentation showing AED basis

Description: Validates FX rate is provided when invoice currency is not AED
Pass Condition: FX rate is present when currency != AED, or currency is AED
Fail Condition: Non-AED currency without FX rate
Suggested Fix: Provide the exchange rate to AED when invoicing in foreign currency
Evidence Required: FX rate source and calculation documentation

Check Name: Payment Due Date Required if Amount Due > 0
Description: Validates payment due date is present when amount is due
Pass Condition: Due date present when amount due > 0, or no amount due
Fail Condition: Amount due exists without payment due date
Suggested Fix: Add payment due date when there is an outstanding amount

Description: Validates specification identifier (IBT-024) is present and starts with allowed UAE PINT-AE prefixes
Pass Condition: Specification identifier is present and starts with an allowed UAE PINT-AE prefix
Fail Condition: Specification identifier is missing or does not start with an allowed UAE PINT-AE prefix
Suggested Fix: Set specification identifier to a valid UAE PINT-AE prefix (billing or selfbilling)

Description: Validates business process type (IBT-023) is present and exactly matches allowed PINT-AE values
Pass Condition: Business process type is present and equals an allowed PINT-AE value
Fail Condition: Business process type is missing or not in allowed PINT-AE values
Suggested Fix: Set business process type to urn:peppol:bis:billing or urn:peppol:bis:selfbilling

Description: Validates seller trading name (IBT-027) is present
Pass Condition: Seller name field is not empty
Fail Condition: Seller name is missing
Suggested Fix: Populate seller name from company master data

Description: Validates Seller TRN matches UAE 15-digit format (IBT-031)
Pass Condition: Seller TRN is exactly 15 digits
Fail Condition: Seller TRN format is invalid
Suggested Fix: Correct the TRN to 15 digits as registered with FTA

Description: Validates seller electronic address endpoint (IBT-034)
Pass Condition: Seller endpoint ID is present
Fail Condition: Seller electronic address is missing
Suggested Fix: Configure seller PEPPOL participant ID or email endpoint

Description: Validates seller legal registration identifier (IBT-030) is present
Pass Condition: Seller legal registration identifier is present
Fail Condition: Seller legal registration identifier is missing
Suggested Fix: Populate seller legal registration identifier from company registration records
Evidence Required: Trade license or legal registration records

Check Name: Seller Legal Registration Identifier Type Present
Description: Validates seller legal registration identifier type (BTUAE-15) is present when seller legal registration identifier exists
Pass Condition: Seller legal registration identifier type is present when seller legal registration identifier exists
Fail Condition: Seller legal registration identifier type is missing when seller legal registration identifier exists
Suggested Fix: Populate seller legal registration identifier type from company registration records
Evidence Required: Trade license or legal registration type records

Description: Validates seller address has required components (IBT-035 to IBT-040)
Pass Condition: Seller street, city, and country code are present
Fail Condition: Seller address is incomplete
Suggested Fix: Complete seller address with street, city, and country code (AE)

Description: Validates UAE emirate/subdivision code (IBT-039)
Pass Condition: Subdivision code is valid UAE emirate code
Fail Condition: Invalid UAE emirate/subdivision code
Suggested Fix: Use valid UAE emirate code (AE-AZ, AE-AJ, AE-FU, AE-SH, AE-DU, AE-RK, AE-UQ)

Description: Validates buyer name (IBT-044) is present
Pass Condition: Buyer name field is not empty
Fail Condition: Buyer name is missing
Suggested Fix: Obtain and populate buyer legal or trading name
Evidence Required: Customer master data or purchase order

Description: Validates Buyer TRN matches UAE 15-digit format when present
Pass Condition: Buyer TRN is exactly 15 digits (when provided)
Fail Condition: Buyer TRN format is invalid
Suggested Fix: Verify buyer TRN with FTA portal or request valid TRN

Description: Validates buyer electronic address endpoint (IBT-049)
Pass Condition: Buyer endpoint ID is present
Fail Condition: Buyer electronic address is missing
Suggested Fix: Configure buyer PEPPOL participant ID or email endpoint

Description: Validates buyer address has required components
Pass Condition: Buyer street, city, country subdivision, and country code are present
Fail Condition: Buyer address is incomplete
Suggested Fix: Complete buyer address fields

Check Name: Sum of Line Net Amounts Matches Header
Description: Validates sum of line net amounts equals header total (IBT-106)
Pass Condition: Sum of line net amounts = Invoice total net amount (within tolerance)
Fail Condition: Line totals do not sum to header amount
Suggested Fix: Reconcile line item amounts with invoice total

Description: Validates total without tax has max 2 decimal places (IBT-109)
Pass Condition: Amount has maximum 2 decimal places
Fail Condition: Amount has more than 2 decimal places
Suggested Fix: Round total amounts to 2 decimal places

Description: Validates total tax amount has max 2 decimal places (IBT-110)
Pass Condition: Tax amount has maximum 2 decimal places
Fail Condition: Tax amount has more than 2 decimal places
Suggested Fix: Round tax amounts to 2 decimal places

Description: Validates total with tax has max 2 decimal places (IBT-112)
Pass Condition: Total amount has maximum 2 decimal places
Fail Condition: Total amount has more than 2 decimal places
Suggested Fix: Round total amounts to 2 decimal places

Check Name: Total With Tax = Without Tax + Tax
Description: Validates total_incl_vat = total_excl_vat + vat_total (IBT-112)
Pass Condition: Total with tax equals sum of net and tax amounts
Fail Condition: Total mismatch: Total != Net + Tax
Suggested Fix: Recalculate invoice totals ensuring Total = Net + VAT

Description: Validates amount due has proper precision (IBT-115)
Pass Condition: Amount due has maximum 2 decimal places
Fail Condition: Amount due precision exceeds 2 decimals
Suggested Fix: Round amount due to 2 decimal places

Description: Validates at least one VAT breakdown is present (IBG-23)
Pass Condition: At least one tax category breakdown exists
Fail Condition: No tax breakdown information provided
Suggested Fix: Add VAT breakdown showing taxable amount and VAT rate per category

PINT Reference Terms: IBT-116; IBT-117; IBT-119; IBT-151; IBT-152; BTUAE-08
Description: Validates tax amount = taxable amount x rate (IBT-117)
Pass Condition: Tax amount = Taxable base x VAT rate (within rounding tolerance)
Fail Condition: Tax calculation does not match formula
Suggested Fix: Verify VAT calculation: Tax = Base x Rate

Check Name: Tax Total = Sum of Tax Breakdown Amounts
Description: Validates total tax equals sum of all tax category amounts
Pass Condition: Sum of tax breakdown amounts = Total tax amount
Fail Condition: Tax breakdown sum does not equal total
Suggested Fix: Reconcile tax breakdown categories with total VAT
Evidence Required: Tax category breakdown vs total reconciliation

Description: Validates invoice has at least one line item (IBG-25)
Pass Condition: Invoice contains one or more line items
Fail Condition: Invoice has no line items
Suggested Fix: Add at least one invoice line with item details

Description: Validates each line has a unique identifier (IBT-126)
Pass Condition: Line identifier is present and unique
Fail Condition: Line identifier is missing or duplicated
Suggested Fix: Assign unique sequential line numbers to each line item

Description: Validates invoiced quantity is present (IBT-129)
Pass Condition: Quantity field is present and numeric
Fail Condition: Quantity is missing or invalid
Suggested Fix: Specify the quantity for each line item

Description: Validates unit of measure is specified (IBT-130)
Pass Condition: Unit of measure code is present
Fail Condition: Unit of measure is missing
Suggested Fix: Add UN/ECE Recommendation 20 unit code (e.g., EA, KGM, MTR)

Description: Validates line net = (qty x price) - allowances + charges (IBT-131)
Pass Condition: Line net amount = (Quantity x Unit Price) - Discount
Fail Condition: Line net calculation is incorrect
Suggested Fix: Verify line calculation: Net = (Qty x Price) - Discount

Check Name: Tax Line Amount Derivable in AED
Description: Validates invoice line amount can be derived in AED using currency/FX policy
Pass Condition: Line amount has AED basis directly or via positive FX conversion
Fail Condition: Line amount in AED cannot be derived due to missing/invalid currency or FX
Suggested Fix: Provide valid FX rate for non-AED invoices and ensure line amounts are populated
Evidence Required: Invoice currency policy, FX source, and line amount reconciliation

Check Name: Commercial Buyer Legal Registration Identifier Present
Description: Validates buyer legal registration identifier is present for commercial invoice profile
Pass Condition: Buyer legal registration identifier is present for applicable commercial invoices
Fail Condition: Buyer legal registration identifier is missing for commercial invoices
Suggested Fix: Populate buyer legal registration identifier or approved buyer identity source field
Evidence Required: Buyer master data and commercial invoice profile policy

Check Name: Commercial Buyer Legal Registration Identifier Type Policy
Description: Validates buyer legal registration identifier type for commercial invoice profile
Pass Condition: Buyer legal registration identifier type is explicit or resolved via approved default
Fail Condition: Buyer legal registration identifier type is missing/invalid for commercial invoices
Suggested Fix: Populate buyer legal identifier type or configure approved default type policy
Evidence Required: Identifier-type policy and master-data mapping evidence

Description: Validates item name is present, with approved fallback to description
Pass Condition: Item name exists directly or can be resolved from description fallback
Fail Condition: Item name and fallback description are both missing
Suggested Fix: Populate item name; if unavailable, ensure description is populated as fallback

Description: Validates item description is present, with approved fallback to item name
Pass Condition: Item description exists directly or can be resolved from item name fallback
Fail Condition: Item description and fallback item name are both missing
Suggested Fix: Populate item description; if unavailable, ensure item name is available as fallback

Description: Validates base-quantity policy for item price using explicit value or approved default
Pass Condition: Base quantity is positive when supplied, or valid default policy is applied
Fail Condition: Base quantity policy is invalid or unsupported for line pricing
Suggested Fix: Provide explicit positive base quantity or configure approved default (typically 1)
Evidence Required: Pricing policy and line calculation configuration evidence

Check Name: Header Tax Category Code In Aligned Tax Category Codes
Description: Validates header tax category code (IBT-118) against Aligned-TaxCategoryCodes codelist
Pass Condition: Header tax category code exists in Aligned-TaxCategoryCodes
Fail Condition: Header tax category code is not in Aligned-TaxCategoryCodes
Suggested Fix: Use a valid aligned VAT category code for the invoice tax breakdown header
Evidence Required: Tax category master-data mapping and invoice tax policy

Check Name: Line Tax Category Code In Aligned Tax Category Codes
Description: Validates line tax category code (IBT-151) against Aligned-TaxCategoryCodes codelist
Pass Condition: Line tax category code exists in Aligned-TaxCategoryCodes
Fail Condition: Line tax category code is not in Aligned-TaxCategoryCodes
Suggested Fix: Use a valid aligned VAT category code for each invoice line
Evidence Required: Line tax category mapping against PINT-AE aligned tax category codes

Description: Validates seller country code (IBT-040) against ISO3166 codelist
Pass Condition: Seller country code exists in ISO3166
Fail Condition: Seller country code is not in ISO3166
Suggested Fix: Use a valid ISO3166 alpha-2 seller country code

Description: Validates buyer country code (IBT-055) against ISO3166 codelist
Pass Condition: Buyer country code exists in ISO3166
Fail Condition: Buyer country code is not in ISO3166
Suggested Fix: Use a valid ISO3166 alpha-2 buyer country code

Check Name: Invoice Type Code UNCL1001 Invoice Context
Description: Validates invoice type code (IBT-003) against UNCL1001-inv for invoice context documents
Pass Condition: Invoice type code exists in UNCL1001-inv when document context is invoice
Fail Condition: Invoice type code is not in UNCL1001-inv for invoice context
Suggested Fix: Use a valid UNCL1001 invoice code for standard invoice context
Evidence Required: Document type mapping table and invoice policy

Check Name: Invoice Type Code UNCL1001 Credit Note Context
Description: Validates invoice type code (IBT-003) against UNCL1001-cn for credit note context documents
Pass Condition: Invoice type code exists in UNCL1001-cn when document context is credit note
Fail Condition: Invoice type code is not in UNCL1001-cn for credit note context
Suggested Fix: Use a valid UNCL1001 credit-note code for credit note context
Evidence Required: Credit-note scenario mapping and document type policy

Description: Validates payment means code (IBT-081) against UNCL4461 codelist when provided
Pass Condition: Payment means code exists in UNCL4461 when value is supplied
Fail Condition: Payment means code is not in UNCL4461
Suggested Fix: Use a valid UNCL4461 payment means code when payment means is supplied
Evidence Required: Payment means configuration and code mapping

Check Name: Unit Of Measure Code UNECE Rec20
Description: Validates unit of measure code (IBT-130) against UNECERec20 codelist
Pass Condition: Unit of measure code exists in UNECERec20
Fail Condition: Unit of measure code is not in UNECERec20
Suggested Fix: Use a valid UNECE Rec20 unit code for each invoiced line
Evidence Required: Unit-of-measure master data and mapping configuration

Description: Validates exempt VAT lines provide an exemption reason code or explanatory reason text
Pass Condition: Exempt VAT lines include exemption reason code or reason text
Fail Condition: Exempt VAT line is missing exemption reason code and explanatory text
Suggested Fix: Populate the exemption reason code and, where used operationally, the supporting reason text for exempt VAT lines
Evidence Required: Tax treatment mapping and exemption documentation

Check Name: Exempt VAT Reason Code In AE Exemption Codes
Description: Validates exempt VAT reason code against Aligned-TaxExemptionCodes when exempt VAT applies
Pass Condition: Exempt VAT reason code exists in Aligned-TaxExemptionCodes
Fail Condition: Exempt VAT reason code is not in Aligned-TaxExemptionCodes
Suggested Fix: Use an approved UAE exemption reason code for exempt VAT lines

Description: Validates reverse-charge VAT lines provide the required goods/services type
Pass Condition: Reverse-charge VAT lines include a goods/services type value
Fail Condition: Reverse-charge VAT line is missing goods/services type
Suggested Fix: Populate the reverse-charge goods/services type for affected invoice lines
Evidence Required: Reverse-charge scenario documentation and goods/services classification

Check Name: Reverse Charge Goods Type In GoodsType Codelist
Description: Validates reverse-charge goods/services type against GoodsType when reverse-charge applies
Pass Condition: Reverse-charge goods/services type exists in the GoodsType codelist
Fail Condition: Reverse-charge goods/services type is not in the GoodsType codelist
Suggested Fix: Use a valid UAE reverse-charge goods/services type code

Check Name: Line VAT Category Rate Semantic Consistency
Description: Validates line-level VAT category, VAT rate, and VAT amount combinations are semantically consistent
Pass Condition: Line VAT category, rate, and amount follow UAE VAT semantic expectations
Fail Condition: Line VAT category conflicts with VAT rate or VAT amount semantics
Suggested Fix: Align VAT category, VAT rate, and VAT amount to the UAE tax treatment for the line
Evidence Required: Line-level tax treatment and VAT calculation policy

Description: Validates header VAT breakdown category/rate semantics stay aligned with line-level reverse-charge and zero/exempt behavior
Pass Condition: Header VAT breakdown category, rate, and tax amount are semantically aligned to the invoice VAT treatment
Fail Condition: Header VAT breakdown conflicts with reverse-charge, exempt, or zero-rated line behavior
Suggested Fix: Align VAT breakdown header category, rate, and tax amount with the line-level UAE VAT treatment
Evidence Required: VAT breakdown reconciliation and tax policy evidence

Check Name: Credit Note Reason Code In CreditReason Codelist
Description: Validates credit note reason code (BTAE-03) against CreditReason when invoice type indicates a credit note
Pass Condition: Credit note reason code exists in CreditReason when document context is credit note
Fail Condition: Credit note reason code is not in CreditReason for credit note context
Suggested Fix: Use a valid UAE credit note reason code for records where invoice_type is a credit note
Evidence Required: Credit note reason-code master data and original adjustment reason evidence

Description: Validates transaction type code (BTUAE-02) is present for UAE invoice scenario routing
Pass Condition: Transaction type code field is not empty
Fail Condition: Transaction type code is missing
Suggested Fix: Populate transaction_type_code using the governed UAE 8-character transaction scenario format
Evidence Required: ERP scenario-routing configuration and transaction-type master data

Description: Validates transaction type code (BTUAE-02) is a decodable 8-character UAE transaction scenario token
Pass Condition: Transaction type code is a valid binary or mask-style 8-character UAE scenario token
Fail Condition: Transaction type code is not a valid binary or mask-style UAE scenario token
Suggested Fix: Normalize transaction_type_code to an 8-character binary or mask token before validation
Evidence Required: ERP transaction-type transformation rules and UAE scenario-routing documentation
